title: 2x Organic Mustard Komatsuna Tendergreen Plug Plants – Hardy Spinach Substitute
description:
Organic Mustard Komatsuna Tendergreen is an

 early-maturing, mild mustard

with

 thick, smooth green leaves

. It is both

 heat and cold tolerant

, making it reliable across the seasons. The leaves are often cooked as greens but can also be eaten raw in salads, similar to spinach. Nutritious and easy to grow, rich in vitamins and minerals.

 Product Details:

   Type:
  
  Organic Mustard Komatsuna Tendergreen
 

   Supplied As:
  
  2x plug plants
 

   Flavour:
  
  Very mild mustard, spinach-like
 

   Growth Habit:
  
  Upright, smooth leaves
 

   Uses:
  
  Salads, cooking greens, spinach substitute
 

 Growing Information:

   Sowing/Planting Months:
  
  Early spring through autumn
 

   Planting Depth:
  
  ¼ inch
 

   Spacing:
  
  6 inches between plants, 18 inches between rows
 

   Light:
  
  Full sun
 

   Watering:
  
  Keep soil moderately moist during germination and growth
 

 Tips:

  Sow/plant every 2–4 weeks for a steady harvest.
 

  Thin gradually to 6 inches apart; thinnings can be eaten in salads.
 

  Harvest outer leaves when young for best flavour, leaving inner leaves to continue growing.
 

  Performs well in both cool and warm conditions.
